acceptanceCriteria: A closed documentation-promotion Work Item is recognized by an explicit, validated marker and does not require an unbounded successor solely to promote its own projection.
Non-documentation Work Items and malformed or missing markers remain fail-closed and still require terminal promotion.
The check-all helper and status consistency checker agree across English, Chinese, and Japanese projections.
Regression tests prove the boundary, preserve no-write behavior on invalid evidence, and prevent recursive promotion.
No Runtime governance evidence, historical Work Item bytes, or user-global configuration is rewritten.
goal: Define and test a bounded, explicit self-terminal boundary for documentation-promotion Work Items across the promotion helper, status consistency check, and governance documentation.
intent: Prevent the terminal documentation promotion check from creating an unbounded self-successor chain while preserving evidence-backed terminal documentation checks.
